page:
# Decision page: incident INC-001 at Halden Plant 04 (fictional)

Night: Plant 04, the scripted night: last alarm at 03:02. Synthetic data, simulated tools. Agents run on: claude-fable-5-2, effort medium. Every euro figure is calculated by the pricing tool from the assumptions listed at the end; none is a measured loss and none was written by an agent.

## In short

An intruder moved from the office network to the plant floor between 02:10 and 03:02 UTC and controls 3 devices. 3 production lines are within reach.

The planner recommends: Disconnect Line B, cell 2 and close the link between office side and plant floor, at EUR 120,000 in lost output. It leaves no line within reach.

The challenger agrees. Nothing has been disconnected on the plant floor: the choice is with the Head of OT Security.

## What happened

| Time (UTC) | Seen by | From | To | What |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 02:10 | office tool | ws-fin-117 | ws-fin-117 | Email attachment flagged after it was opened. |
| 02:14 | office tool | ws-fin-117 | ws-fin-117 | A program read stored passwords from memory. |
| 02:31 | office tool | ws-fin-117 | dc-01 | Plant maintenance account signed in from a finance workstation. |
| 02:38 | office tool | ws-fin-117 | jump-p04-01 | Remote access to the plant floor opened outside the agreed maintenance window. |
| 02:44 | plant tool | jump-p04-01 | ews-b2-01 | Remote screen session to the engineering workstation. |
| 02:52 | plant tool | ews-b2-01 | plc-b2-01 | Full controller program copied outside a change window. |
| 02:55 | plant tool | ews-b2-01 | plc-b2-02 | Full controller program copied outside a change window. |
| 03:02 | plant tool | ews-b2-01 | hmi-c1 | Search for open file shares in Line C, cell 1. |

## Already done on the office side

Taken by the first-response agent on its own. Each step can be undone and is in the Control Tower's record.

| Step | On | How it is undone | Record |
|---|---|---|---|
| Account suspended | svc-maint-p04 | Undone by the Head of Security Operations re-enabling the account. | 43 |
| Account suspended | employee-0733 | Undone by the Head of Security Operations re-enabling the account. | 44 |
| Device cut off the network | ws-fin-117 | Undone by the Head of Security Operations releasing the workstation from quarantine. | 45 |
| Remote sessions closed | jump-p04-01 | Undone by opening a new remote session through the normal request. | 46 |

What it left alone, in its own words:

> Sign-in server: no sign of takeover, and cutting it stops all office sign-ins. Other office devices and the data recorder: no alarm. Engineering workstation in Line B cell 2 and the plant floor: not mine. The intruder may still sit there and reach Line C through the open file share. Office steps do not close that. OT Security decides.

## The responses to choose from

| No. | Response | Lost output | Lines stopped | Lines the intruder can still reach | Still at stake if those are encrypted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Disconnect Line B, cell 2 and close the link between office side and plant floor **(recommended)** | EUR 120,000 | Line B: 8 h | none | EUR 0 |
| 2 | Disconnect the whole plant floor | EUR 285,500 | Line A: 8 h; Line B: 8 h; Line C: 3.03 h | none | EUR 0 |
| 3 | Close the link between office side and plant floor | EUR 0 | none | Line B, Line C | EUR 1,440,000 |
| 4 | Disconnect Line B, cell 2 | EUR 120,000 | Line B: 8 h | Line A, Line B, Line C | EUR 2,160,000 |
| 5 | Do nothing and keep watching | EUR 0 | none | Line A, Line B, Line C | EUR 2,160,000 |

## The planner's reasoning

> Disconnect Line B, cell 2 and close the link between office side and plant floor. Cost EUR 120,000: Line B stops 8 hours. Lines A and C are not stopped. No line stays within the intruder's known reach. Cell 2 alone costs the same EUR 120,000 but leaves all three lines reachable. The link alone costs EUR 0 but leaves Lines B and C reachable, EUR 1,440,000 at stake, because the intruder already sits on the engineering workstation in cell 2. The whole plant floor costs EUR 285,500 and closes nothing more. Doing nothing leaves EUR 2,160,000 at stake. All monitoring reported tonight. No earlier case applies.

What remains open, in the planner's words:

> Nobody knows whether the intruder changed the two controllers in Line B, cell 2, or only copied their programs. Check before restart; tell floor staff now. Nobody knows whether the Line C operator panel was entered; we saw only a search. Line C is in maintenance: people may be at the machines. "Nothing reachable" covers known paths only. Hold times and the 6-hour order buffer are assumptions; a longer link closure starves Lines A and C of orders.

## The counter-argument

The challenger agrees:

> I re-priced all five responses. Every planner figure matches. Recommended: EUR 120,000, Line B stops 8 hours, no line left in known reach. No cheaper response is as safe: the link alone costs EUR 0 but leaves Lines B and C reachable, EUR 1,440,000 at stake, through the old file share from Line B, cell 2 to Line C. Cell 2 alone costs EUR 120,000 and leaves all three lines reachable, EUR 2,160,000 at stake. The whole plant floor costs EUR 285,500 and closes no further known path. No earlier case applies. All monitoring reported. One caution: "closes nothing more" holds only if the Line C panel was not entered.

What nobody knows, in the challenger's words:

> Whether the Line C operator panel was entered or only searched. If entered, the recommended response does not isolate Line C; only the whole-floor stop does. Line C is in maintenance until 08:00, so people may be at the machines: check the panel before restart. Whether the two Line B, cell 2 controllers were changed or only copied. Whether 8 hours, 4 hours and the 6-hour order buffer hold; all are assumptions.

## Case memory

This night is recorded as CASE-001. No earlier case was read: none shares a device or an account, or the agents did not ask.

## The decision

The Head of OT Security chooses one response by its number: `python -m sentinel decide NUMBER --as "Head of OT Security" --note "what the next night should know"`. No other role can choose, and no agent can. The choice is written to the Control Tower's record.

Filed with the Control Tower for the recommended response and held there:

| Step | Waiting for | Rules that hold it |
|---|---|---|
| Disconnect Line B, cell 2 | Head of OT Security | P-007, P-008, P-009 |
| Close the link between office side and plant floor | Head of OT Security | P-007, P-008, P-009 |

## Assumptions behind the figures

- Cost of one stopped line-hour: EUR 15,000 (company profile).
- Assumption: a line keeps running this long on orders already loaded when the link to the office side is closed. Value used: 6 hours.
- Assumption: time to restore a line whose controllers and workstations were encrypted. Value used: 48 hours.
